subject: FRANK
owner_observation: Treat the reported multi-day strong/stable loop-of-loops functional regime as a project primary observation to explain and reproduce; do not treat it as phenomenal-consciousness evidence.

knowledge_return.preservation_law: Preserve every legacy organ/module/policy causal signal, not necessarily its old module boundary.
knowledge_return.migration_gate: D(Sigma_old,Sigma_new)<=epsilon under frozen replay, perturbation and OOD tests, with authority/provenance/recovery preserved.
knowledge_return.historical_natural_lesion: The 2026-03-19 workspace deletion severed model-readable global re-entry while internal state-vector generation continued; use as historical lesion clue, not standalone causal proof.
knowledge_return.broadcast_law: broadcast != global causal closure; require addressed->delivered->reconstructed->uptake->causal_use->outcome->provenance_bound_reentry receipts.
knowledge_return.coupling_target: selective + reversible + outcome-sensitive + multiscale + recoverable; maximum coupling is not the target.
knowledge_return.habituation_law: h_i(t+1)=clip((1-beta_i)h_i(t)+alpha_i q_i(t),0,1); beta_i>0 is required for channels expected to recover. beta_i=0 with persistent activation creates saturation risk.
knowledge_return.recurrence_law: continue only if expected marginal utility exceeds compute + instability + recovery cost and unresolved pressure remains material; low_delta + high_pressure = STALLED.
knowledge_return.stability_law: Do not optimize one global spectral radius. Healthy fixed points, productive bounded cycles and metastable update windows are distinct valid regimes; divergence is outcome/error/cost worsening.
knowledge_return.architecture_hypothesis: Selective Metastable Global Re-entry (SMGR): local specialization -> selective ignition -> receiver-local transformation/use -> verified outcome/credit -> provenance-bound re-entry -> recovery/restabilization.
knowledge_return.measurement: FRIS is a typed vector/profile, never a consciousness scalar: integration, receiver use, re-entry, workspace selectivity, metastability, cross-timescale coupling, lesion/rescue, shuffled/no-reentry controls, directed flow, PID/PEID where justified, macro-vs-micro gain, continuity, utility/cost, recovery and transfer.
knowledge_return.anti_goodhart: Never optimize recurrence, coupling, ignition, emergence or FRIS as a single scalar target. Compare constrained multiobjective/Pareto regimes with negative controls.
knowledge_return.scientific_boundary: recurrence != emergence != consciousness; GWT is an operational mechanism hypothesis, not consciousness proof.

required_experiment.completion_test: Exhaustive Sigma inventory has no silent legacy omissions; A/B/C/D frozen replays emit FRIS + task/cost/recovery receipts; lesions/rescues discriminate causal contributors; OOD and reboot/recovery checks pass or negative results are preserved.

branch_returns.frank: Build exhaustive legacy Sigma inventory and exact pre-lesion topology/timescale map; preserve causal equivalence rather than module names.
branch_returns.gwt: Instrument full selection-to-reentry chain; a workspace row without receiver causal use is not closure.
branch_returns.emergenz: Measure FRIS with causal controls; never promote recurrence or synchronization alone.
branch_returns.claycode: Represent Sigma, multiscale loop state, recoverable gating, receiver receipts, causal credit, re-entry, interventions and equivalence tests in executable semantics.
branch_returns.hyperposition: Use bounded alternative-branch reopening only as an anti-stagnation/attractor-escape mechanism and test destabilization costs.
branch_returns.claygraph: Project sparse typed loop/coupling topology including delay, gain, inhibition, receiver-use and re-entry edges; activation is not causal use.
branch_returns.unifieddb: Persist time-aligned states, receipts, interventions, outcome credit, re-entry lineage and checkpoints sufficient for deterministic FRIS reconstruction.
branch_returns.harness: Execute A/B/C/D frozen replay, regulator factorials, lesions/rescues, finite-difference dynamics and recovery tests before H3 module collapse.
branch_returns.clayresearch: Fuse recurrent control, GWT, causal-emergence, metastability and legacy-function preservation; retain event-driven/sparse-local counterhypotheses.
